_comment: Ground-truth BusinessAnnotations for GET /api/orders. Used by business-translator regression. Pass criterion: narrativeConfidence=high AND ≥ 80% of nodeAnnotations match (by businessLabel synonyms acceptable) AND every annotation has non-empty evidence (anti-fabrication red line).

narrative: 当前用户带着 x-user-id 调用此接口,系统先用中间件解析身份;随后并发查询当前用户的订单列表(按创建时间倒序、分页)与总条数,最后把列表、当前页码、页大小、总条数一起返回。整条链路只读 Order 表,不涉及任何写操作。
narrativeEvidence: src/routes/orders.ts:32-45 (GET 路由 + requireUser 中间件 + 调用 listOrders 并 res.json)
src/services/order-service.ts:68-84 (listOrders 用 Promise.all 并发跑 findMany + count,按 createdAt desc 分页)
